title: Daily routines and free time
vocabulary: Sports, hobbies, days of the week, time
function: Talk about what you do every day

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn how to talk about your daily routine using the Present Simple tense and adverbs of frequency like always, sometimes and never.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. I wake up at 7. She plays tennis on Saturdays. We never watch TV in the morning. Notice how the verb changes with he, she, it: we add -s.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.explanation: With she we add -s to the verb in Present Simple.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 3 sentences about your daily routine: what time you wake up, what you do in the morning and what you do in the evening.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: He ___ goes to the gym on Mondays.
phases.explanation: Always expresses a regular habit. All are valid, but Always fits best with a Monday routine.
